title: A scratch directory
hints: os.MkdirTemp("", "scratch-*") creates a new, empty directory with a unique name and returns its path.
os.Remove only deletes empty directories. os.RemoveAll deletes a directory and everything in it.
defer os.RemoveAll(dir) right after MkdirTemp succeeds, then return fn(dir). Deferred calls run even if fn panics.
